Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor registration & staged payment terms for Novatech pilot

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the demo last week — the pilot looked promising. Procurement asked me to begin vendor setup so we can issue a PO and approve staged payments during the pilot. A few items AP needs from vendors before a PO is created:

- Completed vendor registration form (attached)
- Tax/VAT evidence (W9 for US vendors, VAT registration or certificate for EU vendors)
- Remit-to bank details or Stripe Connect/virtual account info
- Preferred invoice header fields and PO number field mapping
- Confirmation of our ability to split invoices (i.e., 50% milestone / 50% upon delivery)

We generally do Net45 for new vendors but can agree to Net30 for pilots if the supplier requests. Please confirm: will Redwood accept split invoices (two invoices tied to a single PO) and can you provide the company tax id and bank details via our secure portal?

Attached: novatech-vendor-registration-form.pdf (fillable). Our AP contact is ap@novatech.io if you want to loop them in.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — procurement is aiming to get the PO out this week.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Lopez
Senior Procurement Lead, Novatech Systems

Hi Sofia — thanks for the note and the form. Looping in Marissa (sales lead) and Vivek (finance) to help close this out.

Short answers up front:
- Yes, we can accept split invoices tied to the same PO (we typically issue two invoices and reference the PO on both).
- Pilot payment cadence is negotiable; our standard is Net30, but we can accept Net45 for a pilot. For a pilot we often propose 50% upfront to cover initial capacity and 50% on go-live — but we can be flexible.
- I'll attach our AP onboarding packet and a spreadsheet that lists the exact invoice header fields and the values you should expect.

Questions for AP to avoid back-and-forth:
1) Which PO field do you use for line-item-level cost centers (is it the PO# or a separate cost center code?)
2) Can your portal accept direct bank account details or do you require an intermediary (e.g., WIRE only, no ACH)?
3) Any required vendor remit-to name variations (legal name vs. DBA)?

Next steps:
- Attached: redwood-ap-onboarding-packet.pdf and redwood-tax-and-bank-evidence.xlsx — please review and tell us if you need additional formats.
- If you prefer, we can fill the Novatech registration form and upload to your portal; otherwise we will wait for the secure registration link.

Thanks — aiming to provide everything by EOD today.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Marissa's note:
- Recommend we offer a staged invoice plan: 40% deposit, 40% mid-pilot milestone, 20% on completion. That reduces Redwood cash exposure and aligns with deliverables.
- Finance will need a copy of the Novatech vendor form and a secure portal link to submit bank data (do not send bank details over regular email).

Vivek, can you confirm Redwood can do the 3-way split and whether Finance requires any special accounting codes for this type of pilot?

Hi Aditya / Marissa — thanks for the quick responses. A few confirmations from AP:

- We can accept split invoicing against a single PO. Please ensure each invoice references the PO and includes the milestone description (e.g., "Pilot deposit — 40%", "Pilot midpoint — 40%", "Final delivery — 20%").
- Our portal supports direct bank upload through a secure form; we will not accept bank details via standard email. Use the secure link below to register banking and tax info.
- Invoice header requirements: legal vendor name, tax ID, mailing address, invoice date, PO number, line-item descriptions, and a single total. See our invoice template at: https://secure.novatech.io/vendor-portal/invoice-template.
- Novatech standard terms are Net45 for new vendors; Net30 can be offered for approved pilot contracts when finance signs off.

Please complete the vendor registration form and either upload it or allow us to pre-fill from the redwood packet. Once the vendor record is created we'll issue a test PO (PO# NOV-987654) to confirm remittance fields.

Secure upload link: https://secure.novatech.io/vendor-portal/register/ABC123

Attachments: novatech-vendor-registration-form.pdf (the filled form is preferred).

Regards,
Novatech Accounts Payable
